name: Meridian Verified
description: A daily news and public affairs program produced by the Axiom Corp Communications Division, broadcast free on all Tier 1 and Tier 2 flat-screen infrastructure. Meridian Verified presents civic information, safety announcements, and curated current events in a clean, authoritative format. Its editorial staff are corp employees; its fact-checking department reports directly to Axiom Legal. It has never run a story critical of any licensed corponation.
cultural_impact: Meridian Verified is the primary news source for an estimated 60% of Tier 1 adults, making it the single most effective instrument of narrative control in the Shelf.
story_hooks: A Meridian Verified anchor has been quietly passing segment scripts to underground journalists — they want out before their next contract renewal locks them in for a decade.
The 2207 mesh archive analysis exists as a complete document; its author has gone missing and the drive is in play.
A Tier 1 community is preparing to act on information they received from Meridian Verified — information that is verifiably false and will get people killed.
